{{nihongo|'''Hihayo Tenjin Shrine'''|比波預天神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

'''Hihayo Tenjin Shrine''' (ひはよてんじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Usami|ja|宇佐美|qid=Q11449054}}, {{ill|Itō, Shizuoka|ar|إتو (شيزوكا)|arz|اتو (تجمع سكان فى محافظه شيزوكا)|azb|ایتو، شیزوئوکا|ce|Ито (гӀала)|ceb|Itō|da|Itō (Shizuoka)|de|Itō (Shizuoka)|eo|Ito (Ŝizuoka)|es|Itō (Shizuoka)|et|Itō|fa|ایتو، شیزوئوکا|fi|Itō (Shizuoka)|fr|Itō|gl|Itō|he|איטו (יפן)|hu|Itó (Sizuoka)|id|Itō, Shizuoka|it|Itō|ja|伊東市|ko|이토시|lt|Itas|mzn|ایتو، شیزوئوکا|nl|Ito (Shizuoka)|pl|Itō|pt|Ito (Shizuoka)|ro|Itō (localitate)|ru|Ито (город)|sv|Ito|tg|Ито|th|อิโต|tl|Itō|tr|Itō|tt|Ито (шәһәр)|uk|Іто (Сідзуока)|ur|ایٹو، شیزوکا|vi|Itō, Shizuoka|war|Itō, Shizuoka|zh|伊東市|zh_classical|伊東市|zh_min_nan|Itô-chhī|zh_yue|伊東|qid=Q721163}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}<ref name="jinjacho">[http://shizuoka-jinjacho.or.jp/shokai/jinja.php?id=4402263 比波預天神社] - Shizuoka Prefecture Association of Shinto Shrines</ref>.

=== Overview ===
It stands in the Tomata area, where Usami fishing port is located, in the northern part of {{ill|Usami|ja|宇佐美|qid=Q11449054}}. It is on the foothills north of Karasu River, along {{ill|Higashiura-ji|ja|東浦路|qid=Q11527746}}, the old road route<ref name="is2024-7-7">[https://digital.izu-np.co.jp/photo/37773/45760 リアル東浦路（５）ＪＲ網代駅海側―宇佐美海岸・西留田] - {{ill|Izu Shimbun|ja|伊豆新聞|qid=Q11380576}} 2024/7/7</ref>.

Its foundation is unknown, but since it is identified with the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Karihayasutake Hihayo-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (かりはやすたけ ひはよのみことじんじゃ), its origin goes back to ancient times<ref name="city-bunka"/>.

At the annual festival in mid-October, events include the mikoshi sea procession.

=== Enshrined deity ===
* Karihayasutake Hihayo-no-Mikoto (かりはやすたけ ひはよのみこと). A stone marker says he is a prince of Mishima Ōkami, while shrine tradition says he is the eldest son of Mishima Kuitsu-mimi-no-Kami.

=== Cultural properties ===
* Main sanctuary (with two attached {{ill|Munafuda|ja|棟札|zh|上樑記牌|qid=Q8008834}}) - city-designated building<ref name="city-bunka">[https://www.city.ito.shizuoka.jp/gyosei/soshikikarasagasu/shogaigakushuka/bunka_supotsu/2/2/1/2430.html 比波預天神社本殿 附棟札2枚] - Itō City</ref>.

The {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Elaeocarpus tree}} in the precincts was formerly a prefectural natural monument, but its designation was removed in January 2024 after it fell due to long-term insect damage<ref name="is2024-7-7"/>.
